verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded's platform overview lists "Generate payroll reports" as a payroll capability, so reporting is the product's own documented feature, but this is a single bullet with no detail. missing for 10: documentation of payroll register reports, gross-to-net report breakdowns, export formats (CSV/XLSX) or report API endpoints, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can generate payroll registers and gross-to-net reports and export them for analysis
